statement: קופת גמל לחיסכון, קופת גמל לתגמולים וקופת גמל אישית לפיצויים

source.title: חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל), התשס"ה-2005, ספר החוקים 2009 (ס"ח תשס"ה, 889): s.1 (p.2), s.13 (p.8: "הממונה רשאי לאשר"), s.39(א) (p.15: a managing company is under the Commissioner's supervision)

regulator.notes: A provident fund for tagmulim or a personal severance fund is a provident fund approved under s.13; since 2008 new money in it is pension savings, a provident fund for annuity that does not itself pay the annuity (s.13(א)(4), PEN-34). Managing companies are under the Commissioner's supervision (s.39(א)).

source.title: תקנות הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל) (דמי ניהול), התשע"ב-2012, ק"ת 7131, p.1260 (file p.4), reg. 2(א)(2): "בשיעור שלא יעלה על 4%"

deposit.notes: Maximum fee on payments transferred for each member to a provident fund under regulation 2 (tagmulim and personal severance funds among them). The 2024 average charged in provident funds was 0.09% of deposits (PEN-24).

source.title: תקנות הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל) (דמי ניהול), התשע"ב-2012, ק"ת 7131, p.1260 (file p.4), reg. 2(א)(1): "בשיעור שלא יעלה על 1.05% לשנה"

balance.notes: Maximum fee per year of each member's balance. Money deposited before tax year 2008: the higher of this or up to NIS 6 a month, indexed (reg. 2(א)(2א)); pensioners 0.6%, 0.3% for old-age pensions in insurance-based funds from 1 February 2022. The 2024 average charged was 0.54% of assets (PEN-24).

labels: blocked: the fund does not pay annuities; in a pension fund the money moved joins the balance and is converted at that fund's own factors, and no text obliges a pension fund or an insurer to accept it (PEN-63); an insurer's factors for it are open (PEN OQ19, PEN OQ7; G-03)
an early withdrawal is taxed at the higher of 35% and the marginal rate, on the whole amount paid (TXP-18); F-48 is not in the engine yet, so it is not computed (G-06, closed 2026-10-26)
how gains on the lump sums the law allows are taxed is open (TXP OQ9)

source.title: חוק גיל פרישה, התשס"ד-2004, p.1, s.5 (early retirement age "גיל 60 לגבר ולאישה"); Mor comprehensive pension fund bylaws 01.06.2025, s.1 "גיל זכאות מינימלי לקצבת זקנה" and s.41

age.notes: The fund does not pay an annuity itself ("קופת גמל לא משלמת לקצבה"): money deposited from 2008 is taken as an annuity by transferring it to a pension fund or an insurer, from that fund's minimum eligibility age, 60 (PEN-26, PEN-34). Employee money deposited up to the end of 2007 can be withdrawn as a lump sum at 60 (PEN-34).

source.title: תקנות מס הכנסה (כללים לאישור ולניהול קופות גמל) (תיקון מס' 3), התשס"ה-2005, קובץ התקנות 6380 (10.4.2005), סריקת רשומות, file p.3 (gazette p.603), reg. 9 (in reg. 41יא '5 ימי עסקים' becomes '4 ימי עסקים', with the deferral to the fourth business day of the month); reg. 41יא itself as substituted by קובץ התקנות 6332, file p.19 (gazette p.873), reg. 44
source.quote: רשאית הקופה לדחות את מועד התשלום ליום העסקים הרביעי באותו חודש

payout_business_days.notes: Rule 41יא(א) of the 1964 Income Tax Rules: a provident fund pays a withdrawal within 4 business days of the day the request reaches it; if that date falls in the month's first three business days it may defer to the 4th business day of the month. The law's timetable for every fund, not one company's (scope pass 2026-10-25).

lawful_exit.text: new money (from 2008) leaves lawfully only as an annuity, by moving it to a pension fund or an insurer from age 60; before that only the severance component on leaving a job, a new account for released severance or beneficiary money, small balances past mandatory retirement age, or health and income conditions allow a lump sum; a non-compliant withdrawal is taxed at the higher of 35% and the marginal rate on the whole amount paid (the non-compliant withdrawal rule); F-48 is not in the engine yet, so early withdrawal is not computed; the annuity is blocked too, because no conversion factors are collected: in a pension fund the money joins the balance and is converted at that fund's own factors, no text obliges a pension fund or an insurer to accept it (PEN-63), and an insurer's factors are open (F-49, G-03, PEN OQ7, PEN OQ19)

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance, s.87(א)(2) (Tax Authority's text, p.145): the charge on provident money paid out against the rules reaches only sums a fund paid "לחבריה"; with the transfer regulations 2008, reg. 2(ב), which carry all payment dates over to the receiving fund (only "לעניין דיני המס" when it is an insurer's fund); except severance money moved to a "new account", taxed before it moves (Provident Funds Law s.23(א)(2א))

switch_is_tax_event.notes: A track switch inside the fund is completed within 3 business days and is not a withdrawal (PF-23). A member's move to another provident fund for annuity or a pension fund under the transfer regulations is not a payment to the member, so it is not taxed and the money keeps its tax history (TXP-32); the member is taxed only when money is paid out (TXP-13). One exception (TXP-32): severance money moved to a "new account" in a provident fund for annuity that is not a pension fund or central fund, an account closed to further deposits, has income tax withheld on the part not exempt as severance before it moves (Provident Funds Law s.23(א)(2א), Amendment 13, ספר החוקים 2507 p.17, https://fs.knesset.gov.il/20/law/20_lsr_315848.pdf#page=5); severance money taxed that way but neither withdrawn nor moved counts as new-account money after three months (s.23(ב2)(1)). Transfer regulations, reg. 2(ב) (קובץ התקנות 6657 p.628): https://free-justice.openapi.gov.il/free/moj/portal/rest/searchpredefinedapi/v1/SearchPredefinedApi/Documents/dDKkjTfMz0H3iRxP7u8fpoeVB94OXb~VXxIiNxEmuFE=#page=4. Replaces the 2026-10-22 note, which left the move between funds open (SW OQ8).

transfer_routes.condition: into an annuity-paying fund; insurance underwriting and qualifying period start at the receiving fund
permitted money types only, up to the IRA ceiling; severance money only with the employer's approval

eligibility.text: employees, through an employer, and the self-employed; the bylaws take up to 7.5% employer tagmulim, 7% employee tagmulim and 8.33% severance of the wage; it satisfies mandatory pension only if death and disability cover is held elsewhere, and a self-employed person may meet the deposit duty in it; no pooled insurance, no guaranteed-return share, no actuarial balancing

protection.text: assets are held in trust, separately from the managing company's property, and cannot be attached; if the company fails, management moves to another company; the state does not guarantee the fund's value; the fund is not an eligible fund for the state guaranteed-return mechanism and has no actuarial balancing, so the balance moves only with the track's investments
